prompts.hall: Create a 16:9 landscape Roku game background for the UPSTAIRS HALL of Genevieve's Backyard, matching exactly the warm polished hand-painted children's storybook style, wide front-facing camera and rich real furniture materials of the supplied living-room image. A cozy upstairs landing with cream walls, honey oak floor, soft sunlit lighting, a long soft runner rug and a few framed family pictures and small wall sconces. Four REAL paneled wooden bedroom doors evenly spaced along the back wall, centers near x=170,470,770,1070 in 1280x720 coordinates. Each door occupies roughly x=center+-100, top y=150, bottom y=480, with natural oak framing and brass knobs. Door colors from left to right: pale dusty lavender, gentle buttery yellow, muted sage, warm natural dark wood. Small blank name plaques at eye level on doors, NO readable words. Clear open landing floor across the central and lower-left areas for walking. At the FAR LOWER-RIGHT edge, near x=1100,y=600, build a proper architectural stairwell opening descending downstairs out of view, with honey oak banister, white spindles, visible descending treads and wall attachment; real stairwell in the side of the landing, not a freestanding staircase in the middle of the floor. The player approaches the top step at x=1100,y=590 to go down. Single continuous illustrated house interior, no people, no characters, no game interface, no floating text cards, no buttons, no watermark. All four doors clearly visible and reachable across the open floor.
prompts.seating: Create a character seating sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 equal horizontal cells in one row on a genuine transparent background, matching the supplied Genevieve character exactly: little girl with short wavy brown bob, brown eyes, pink bow, pink floral dress, pink shoes, warm detailed storybook illustration. Cell 1 FRONT seated pose, cell 2 LEFT-facing seated pose, cell 3 RIGHT-facing seated pose, cell 4 front three-quarter seated pose. In EVERY cell her hips and bottom rest on an imaginary horizontal seat surface at about 58% of the cropped character height. Her back is upright, BOTH thighs rest horizontally on that seat plane, BOTH knees bend naturally, shins and shoes dangle below the seat plane. Hands rest naturally in her lap. Show the entire body including hair bow, hands, knees and shoes; exactly two arms and two legs. Do NOT draw any furniture, seats, cushions, props, chairs, ground or shadows. Consistent head/body scale and hip baseline across the four poses. This is a high quality painted 2D game sprite, NO blocky shapes, NO pixel art, NO text, no grid or border, generous transparent padding separating four cells. Her body will be composited ABOVE the seat surface with legs over its front edge, not centered inside a chair.
